relevantSettings: Open Discord on startup (Settings → Windows Settings)
startupBehavior: Starts at sign-in by default (Run key 'Discord'), minimised to the tray.

commonProblems.problem: Black or grey screen / UI glitches
fixes: Toggle Settings → Advanced → Hardware Acceleration and restart Discord.
Clear the Discord cache (console action).
Update the GPU driver.
Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone: allow desktop apps.
Discord → Voice & Video: choose the correct input device and run Mic Test.
Turn off 'Exclusive mode' for the mic in the Sound control panel if another app grabs it.

commonProblems.problem: Stuck on 'Checking for updates' / update loop
fixes: Close Discord fully (tray icon → Quit).
Clear the cache.
Reinstall from discord.com — settings are stored in the account.
Windows Sound → Communications tab → 'Do nothing' (Settings Explorer → Sound → Communications activity).
Disable the in-game overlay for that game.
Turn off hardware acceleration if the GPU is low-end.

repair: Clear the cache, then restart Discord.
Reinstall: uninstall, then download the installer from discord.com.
reset: Clearing the cache keeps login and settings.
A full reset (sign-out + removing %APPDATA%\discord) should only be done with the customer present.
safeUninstall: Close the application first.
Uninstall from Settings → Apps → Installed apps (or from its page in the Application Library), using the vendor's own uninstaller.
Restart if the uninstaller asks.
Leftover user data (if any) stays in AppData — remove only with the customer's agreement.
